text: Living a healthy life involves more than just avoiding illness; it’s about building habits that support your whole self. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the energy it needs. Regular exercise, even a daily thirty-minute walk, strengthens your heart and lifts your mood. Equally important is sleep—aim for seven to nine hours each night so your mind can recharge. Don’t forget mental health: take time to relax, practice mindfulness, or talk to a friend when you feel stressed. Finally, strike a work-life balance by setting boundaries, taking breaks, and making room for hobbies. Small, consistent choices create a healthier, happier you.
